title: 1991 radio caller: underground work alongside alien-like beings
place_text: Underground test site, Nevada (Las Vegas radio)

tellings.quote: 1991, a caller into a Las Vegas radio show claimed he was hired to run electricity 3,000 ft underground on a certain test site, a job that came through Reynolds Electronics, an EG subsidiary. [music] He also said that military personnel were working alongside beings that resembled aliens.

plain: In 1991 a caller to a Las Vegas radio show said he had been hired to run electricity 3,000 feet underground at a Nevada test site, through Reynolds Electronics, a subsidiary of the defense contractor EG&G, and that military personnel there were working alongside beings that looked like aliens. Michels tells this himself, in an episode with a NASA doctor, as something from the record of that broadcast, without naming the caller. If true, it would mean the government is working with non-human beings underground.
